decisions.decision: PAF is a progressive-refinement and assurance framework, not an agent runtime.
The generic layers are Intent, Problem Model, Solution Model, System Model, Activity Model, and Work Graph.
Architecture is a human/domain alias for System Model.
All model transitions use one propose-validate-critique-repair-assess-promote protocol.
Use one typed envelope with model-specific payloads.
Semantic state is an append-only accepted-event ledger plus immutable artifacts.
Work requests CapabilityContracts; adapters may use Python, C++, CLI, MCP, local or remote execution.
Dynamic routing may change execution route but not semantic objective, permissions, evaluator, or promotion policy.
Reuse external agent, workflow, and search frameworks rather than rebuilding them.
RAG produces immutable ContextPackages and is never authoritative memory.
AssessmentProtocol and evaluator integrity are mandatory for engineering, optimization, and research claims.
Failures are repaired at the model layer where the defect exists.
EvolveHLS evolves tool capabilities; FIZZ refines designs using exposed capabilities.
Capability gaps may create independent tool-evolution intents.
The current Cline bootstrap is stage-0 and migrates incrementally behind PAF contracts.
Controller-owned identity, exact-base binding, authorization, validation, and human merge gates remain mandatory during self-hosting.
